---
title: "Welcome"
---

These are hands-on workshops. You won't watch slides about AI, you'll experience AI-augmented work directly, using VS Code + Claude Code: an agentic AI tool that reads files, writes files, and runs commands on your machine. Until recently this stack belonged to software engineers. Now it belongs to everyone, consultants, product managers, and researchers included. Both sessions put that claim to the test with your own hands on the keyboard, then ask what it means for the research we should be doing.
